MORE THAN A FLIGHT. ✈️💛

Sometimes an airplane’s most meaningful destination is an appointment someone otherwise couldn’t reach.

In a November 3 announcement, Air Care Alliance welcomed Daniel Cheung to its board—a new role for someone already deeply involved in public benefit flying.

Working with Cutter Aviation, Cheung has completed more than 50 missions benefiting Angel Flight West passengers since 2024. He also serves on Angel Flight West’s board and received the National Aeronautic Association’s Champion of Public Benefit Flying Award in 2024.

His next chapter supports a much bigger community. Air Care Alliance represents more than 50 volunteer pilot organizations whose missions include medical transportation, animal relocation and educational flights.

That’s general aviation with a purpose: people sharing their time, skills and resources to help others get where they need to go.

Here’s to the pilots, coordinators and supporters making those connections possible. 💛
